title: rhus toxicodendron var. negundo
intro: Rhus toxicodendron var. negundo, commonly known as the Chinese Sumac or Man Jing Zi in traditional Chinese medicine, is a plant species belonging to the family Anacardiaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, such as eczema and dermatitis. The therapeutic actions of Rhus toxicodendron var. negundo are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce swelling and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
